# Advisories the `govulncheck` CI job accepts while they are reachable.
# Read by .github/scripts/vulngate.py; its rules are in CONTRIBUTING.md.
#
# One entry per line:   GO-YYYY-NNNN  YYYY-MM-DD  reason
#
# The date is the LAST day the entry is honoured (UTC). After it the job
# FAILS and names the entry, whether or not the advisory is still reported:
# remove it, or re-date it with a fresh reason. Use an entry only when no
# fixed release exists yet (or the fix cannot land yet); otherwise make the
# bump govulncheck names. Keep dates short: weeks, not months.
#
# (no entries)
